manifest.name: Hyprland Layout Switcher
manifest.description: Aesthetic Hyprland layout switcher with status bar widget, dual scope (global/workspace), and schematic wireframe hub.

default_scope.label: Default Layout Scope
default_scope.description: Select whether layout changes apply globally to all workspaces or specifically to the active workspace by default.

show_label_in_bar.label: Show Layout Name in Bar
show_label_in_bar.description: Display the textual name of the active layout beside the glyph in the status bar widget.

notify_on_change.label: Notification on Layout Change
notify_on_change.description: Show a desktop notification whenever the layout is switched.

enable_hy3.label: Enable Hy3 Plugin Layout
enable_hy3.description: Include the third-party hy3 i3/sway-like manual tiling layout in the switcher rotation and panel.

widget.tooltip:
Hyprland Layout: {layout} ({scope})
Left-click: Quick cycle • Right-click: Layout Hub

panel.title: Hyprland Layout Switcher
panel.hint: Left-click bar widget to cycle • Right-click to open this panel

dwindle.name: Dwindle
dwindle.description: Dynamic spiral tiling layout with automatic Fibonacci window splits.

master.name: Master
master.description: Fixed primary master window column flanked by stacked slave window tiles.

hy3.name: Hy3
hy3.description: i3/sway style manual container groups with horizontal, vertical, and tabbed splits.

scrolling.name: Scrolling
scrolling.description: Infinite horizontal carousel tape of window columns.

scroller.name: Scrolling
scroller.description: Infinite horizontal carousel tape of window columns.

monocle.name: Monocle
monocle.description: Single-window focus where windows expand to fill the entire workspace.
